Survivor gleitman1965coordinating is the 1965 Language journal article (vol 41, DOI 10.2307/411878). Member gleitman1969coordinating is a 1969 incollection (Prentice-Hall, pp 80-112) with NO DOI and a different year — it carries no DOI so it was matched on title+author only, but the year and venue differ (1969 book chapter vs 1965 journal article). Likely a distinct reprint/version; flag the odd one out.
